name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official rulebook and starter plugins for extending the Cursor AI code editor with new capabilities.
buyer: A developer tools company wanting to integrate their product directly into Cursor's AI coding workflow.
business_use_cases: A dev tools startup, like a database or API platform, builds an official plugin so developers can manage their service without leaving the editor.
A security company builds a plugin that scans AI-generated code for vulnerabilities before it's committed.
An enterprise builds an internal plugin connecting to its own APIs and docs so the AI assistant has company-specific context.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a premium plugin for an underserved niche, like compliance checks or internal API access, to companies standardizing on Cursor.

steal_this: Build a simple plugin this weekend that connects to one popular SaaS API, like Stripe or Linear, and publish it for other developers to use.
